verdict.rationale: CT Corporation offers compliance and entity-management software, so an embedded AI assistant that can connect to MCP servers is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence pack holds only robots.txt probes: the main host returned a Cloudflare challenge, and the legacy host redirects into it. No product content was reachable, so nothing shows MCP-client support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
